column1: From: Vanni, M.J. and J.A. Gephardt 2011. Metabolic ecology: How do body size and temperature affect nutrient cycling rates? TEACHING ISSUES AND EXPERIMENTS IN ECOLOGY, 7
Each line is for one fish, collected from a lake in Ohio
temp_C refers to the temperature of lake water at the time the experiment was conducted
mass_g is the wet mass of the fish
N_u.h is the rate at which the fish excreted nitrogen, via urine, in units of µmoles per fish per hour
P_u.h is the rate at which the fish excreted phosphorus via urine, in units of µmoles per fish per hour
